# langsmith_bulk_export (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a LangSmith bulk export by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_bulk_export" "example" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the bulk export.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace ID. If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `bulk_export_destination_id` (String) The UUID of the bulk export destination.
- `compression` (String) The compression type.
- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp.
- `end_time` (String) The end time for the export in RFC3339 format.
- `export_fields` (List of String) List of fields included in the export.
- `filter` (String) A filter expression for the export.
- `finished_at` (String) The timestamp when the export finished.
- `format` (String) The export format.
- `format_version` (String) The format version (`v1` or `v2_beta`).
- `interval_hours` (Number) The interval in hours for recurring exports.
- `session_id` (String) The UUID of the project/session being exported.
- `start_time` (String) The start time for the export in RFC3339 format.
- `status` (String) The status of the bulk export.
- `tenant_id` (String, Deprecated) Deprecated: use `workspace_id` instead.
- `updated_at` (String) The last update timestamp.
